export_evidence: ImportKey India customs page (https://importkey.com/countries/india/espee-international) — counter states "Total Shipments 3 Records detected", 3 rows actually visible. Exact rows: "2025-12-03 | ESPEE INTERNATIONAL | INDIAN BLACK TEA-OA -1003A(AS PER INV.)WE INTEND TO CLAIM REWARDS UNDER RODTEP | KOLKATA SEA, India -> Umm Qasr, IRAQ | HS 09024010 | BOL 7541831"; "2025-09-15 | ESPEE INTERNATIONAL | THE ORDER OF YENER GENERAL TRADING LLC | INDIAN BLACK TEA-CN-005(AS PER INV.)WE INTEND TO CLAIM REWARDS UNDER RODTEP | KOLKATA SEA, India -> JEBEL ALI, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | HS 9024020 | BOL 8837530"; "2025-09-15 | ... INDIAN BLACK TEA-OA -1001 ... JEBEL ALI, UNITED ARAB EMIRATES | HS 9024020 | BOL 8837530". Address on record: 62/1A, N.S. ROAD, 3RD FLOOR, ROOM NO. 31 (Kolkata).
note: Export side is factually confirmed: 3 real customs shipping-bill records with dates (15.09.2025 and 03.12.2025), destinations UAE (Jebel Ali) and Iraq (Umm Qasr), HS 09024010 (black tea, >3kg) — matches declared HS 090240. Two of the three rows show HS printed as '9024020' (leading zero dropped by the source), i.e. 09024020. Declared HS 090111/090230/091099 not observed in the visible records; per project rules this is not a rejection ground — actual code is 09024010/09024020. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts) could not be retrieved: DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection refused on both attempts, volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, and no public GST/tender record was found — recorded as null/unknown, not as 'no supplies'. Revenue and export volume figures are not public in the free view — null. Role: appears to be a merchant exporter of Kolkata black tea (trader/exporter), not a manufacturer. No rejection grounds (entity exists and is actively shipping).
